stem: An early reproductive structure at a node is not developed enough for confident classification. What is the best evidence-based action?
choices: Record its location and current morphology, mark the classification uncertain, and re-inspect as it develops
Classify it from the seed package description
Remove it immediately so the record contains no uncertainty
Assume it is pistillate unless pollen has already been observed
rationale: Direct reproductive morphology should support classification. When morphology is ambiguous, documenting uncertainty and repeating observation is more defensible than using a label or assumption.
